audit_items.proof_trace: Both ADL entry points (`liquidate_adl_borrow` L224, `liquidate_adl_deposit` L273) call `pre_liquidation_check` with `whitelist_admin::adl()` (bit 3), which calls `ensure_has_permission` checking `(permission & (1u32 << 3)) != 0`. A cap with only liquidation permission (bit 2, value 4) gives `4 & 8 = 0` → abort. The underlying `handle_debt_auto_deleverage` / `handle_collateral_auto_deleverage` are `public(package)` — no bypass path exists outside the protocol package.
